title: Checkpoint: trace a recursive call
prompt: Trace `f(5)` frame by frame: f(5) → f(3) → f(1) → f(-1). Predict the return value by hand, then implement `f` yourself from the trace (same shape, your own lines).

tests.name: recursive trace
tests.hint: f(5)=5+f(3)=5+3+f(1)=5+3+1+f(-1)=5+3+1+1=10 — check your arithmetic, then encode f(n<=0)->1, f(n)=n+f(n-2).
